title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient sequential recommendation has emerged as a promising paradigm for providing real-time personalized service. To deploy models under resource-constrained environment, model compression becomes a necessity, yet existing methods typically apply uniform compression ratios, overlooking the heterogeneity in user intent complexity. This "one-size-fits-all" approach leads to a fundamental Capacity-Complexity Mismatch, where computational resources are either wasted on simple instances or insufficient for complex ones. To address this, we propose RACE (Ranking-uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation), a framework that dynamically adapts both model structures and input sequences with uncertainty-aware compression ratios. To ensure capacity-adaptive inference, RACE captures the model's intrinsic uncertainty of its predictions and transforms it into a proactive resource allocator. Specific

translated_title: RACE：面向高效序列推荐的排序不确定性感知容量自适应定制
translated_abstract: 高效序列推荐已成为提供实时个性化服务的一种有前景的范式。为了在资源受限的环境下部署模型，模型压缩成为必要手段，然而现有方法通常采用统一的压缩比率，忽视了用户意图复杂性的异质性。这种“一刀切”的方式导致了根本性的“容量-复杂度失配”问题，即计算资源要么浪费在简单实例上，要么对复杂实例而言不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RACE（排序不确定性感知的容量自适应定制框架），该框架利用不确定性感知的压缩比率，动态调整模型结构和输入序列。为实现容量自适应推理，RACE捕获模型预测的内在不确定性，并将其转化为一种主动的资源分配器……
tldr: 提出RACE框架，通过捕获模型预测的排序不确定性并将其转化为主动的资源分配器，以不确定性感知的压缩比率动态调整模型结构和输入序列，从而解决序列推荐中统一压缩比率导致的容量-复杂度失配问题，实现资源受限环境下的高效推荐。
en_tdlr: RACE is a framework that leverages ranking uncertainty of model predictions as a proactive resource allocator, dynamically adapting both model structures and input sequences with uncertainty-aware compression ratios to resolve the capacity-complexity mismatch in efficient sequential recommendation.
